mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5pp over the previous 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs per month compared to the previous 3-month average, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth slows by > 100k jobs/mo vs. 3mo avg
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth slows by > 100k jobs/mo vs. 3mo avg but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market and consumer demand that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST growth accelerates by >10% but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth decelerates by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a weakening supply chain and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth decelerates by >2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate and the consumer price index are both rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy with high inflation that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is positive and accelerating, and the unemployment rate is falling, it signals a strong economic expansion that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth positive and accelerating, UNRATE falling, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.
